case_summary: Over four days, resident ate less, slept more during the day, became mixed up about the time of day and needed more help transferring.

timeline.note: Ate about half of breakfast and lunch
Asked several times if it was morning
Needed one-person assist to transfer, usually independent

documented_outcome: Nurse assessment found a low-grade temperature; the NP diagnosed a respiratory infection treated in the home. Back to usual routine by day 10.
limitations: No vital signs recorded before day 3.

case_summary: Over six days, resident drank and ate less, urinated less often, became sleepy and then unsteady walking.

timeline.note: Drank about half of usual fluids
Voided twice in 24 hours, urine dark

documented_outcome: Bloodwork showed dehydration; a hydration plan was started and the resident recovered over one week.
limitations: Fluid intake was not recorded on days 1 to 3.

case_summary: Rapid change over three days: poor intake, drowsiness, new confusion and inability to walk to the dining room.

timeline.note: Ate a few bites of breakfast
New confusion, calling out for family
Could not walk to dining room, used wheelchair

documented_outcome: Transferred to hospital on day 3 after a nurse found low oxygen saturation; admitted with pneumonia.
limitations: Record does not include hospital discharge details.

case_summary: Over five days, resident ate less, seemed sedated in the mornings and was unsteady walking.

timeline.note: Unsteady on feet, needed standby to hands-on assist

documented_outcome: Medication review found a sedating medication started the week before; the dose was reduced and changes resolved within four days.
limitations: Exact start date of the new medication is unclear.

case_summary: Over a week, resident ate less, withdrew from activities and visitors, and walked less.
documented_outcome: Assessed by the NP; no medical cause found. The team noted low mood, and the resident returned to usual pattern over two weeks after family visits and activity changes.
limitations: No mood screening score documented.

case_summary: Over four days, resident had no bowel movement, ate less, became tired, held their stomach and needed more help walking.

timeline.note: No bowel movement for three days
Ate about half of lunch and dinner
Holding stomach, said it felt full

documented_outcome: Constipation confirmed (no bowel movement for five days); bowel routine adjusted and intake recovered.
limitations: Bowel records incomplete for the prior week.

case_summary: Over five days, resident ate less at most meals, seemed unusually tired, and began needing more help walking.
documented_outcome: Care team requested a clinical assessment; a medical cause was identified and treated.
limitations: Record does not state the resident's baseline mobility or any medication changes.

case_summary: Over five days, resident ate less, was tired and walked less, with new reports of knee pain.

timeline.note: Reluctant to walk to dining room
Rubbing right knee, said it ached

documented_outcome: Urine culture negative; the NP attributed the changes to worsening arthritis pain. Pain plan adjusted and mobility improved partially.
limitations: Pain scores not recorded until day 4.

case_summary: Over six days, resident ate and drank less, was drowsy and needed help walking; two others on the unit had similar changes.
documented_outcome: COVID-19 test positive on day 2; resident isolated and recovered in the home. Two other residents on the unit tested positive that week.
limitations: Onset dates for the other residents are not recorded in this case.

case_summary: For three days after a room move, resident slept poorly, ate less, was tired and slightly unsteady.

timeline.note: Awake much of the night in new room

documented_outcome: Changes resolved without treatment by day 5. Nurse noted a disrupted sleep schedule after the room move.
limitations: Short follow-up; no clinical assessment documented.

case_summary: Over five days, resident ate and drank less, slept most of the day, stopped joining others and stopped walking to meals.

timeline.note: No longer coming out to the lounge
Stayed in wheelchair for all transfers

documented_outcome: Resident declined further assessment in line with advance care wishes; comfort-focused care continued and family was updated.
limitations: Cause of the change was not investigated.

case_summary: Resident ate less and seemed tired for two days. No mobility change recorded.
documented_outcome: Symptoms resolved after a medication timing adjustment. No further concerns.
limitations: Short observation window; no follow-up beyond day 4.

case_summary: Resident ate less, was drowsy and briefly confused before lunch for three days.
documented_outcome: Low blood sugar episodes found; diabetes medication adjusted.
limitations: Blood glucose checked only once daily.

case_summary: Resident ate much less, was tired and irritable, and winced when chewing for two days.

timeline.note: Ate only soft parts of meals, about 40%
Winced when chewing on the left

documented_outcome: Dental abscess found; dental visit arranged and intake recovered after treatment.
limitations: Mouth not examined until day 2.

case_summary: Over four days, resident ate and drank less and was very tired, with new aches.

timeline.note: Very tired, stayed in bed for breakfast
Ate about a quarter of meals
Drank about half of usual fluids

documented_outcome: Influenza confirmed by swab; antiviral started. Resident recovered over ten days.
limitations: Vaccination status not recorded in this case.

case_summary: Resident ate less and seemed tired for five days.
documented_outcome: No cause found on assessment; appetite and energy returned without intervention by day 8.
limitations: No weight recorded.

case_summary: Over three days, resident ate less, was lethargic and became muddled in conversation.

timeline.note: Lost track of conversation, unusual for her

documented_outcome: Bloodwork showed low sodium; the NP adjusted a diuretic and the resident improved.
limitations: Baseline bloodwork was more than six months old.

case_summary: Over six days after a roommate died, resident ate less and withdrew from usual activities and friends.
documented_outcome: Team identified grief; social work and chaplain visits followed and intake improved slowly.
limitations: No standardized mood assessment completed.

case_summary: Resident ate less, seemed tired and complained of a sore mouth for two days.

timeline.note: Ate about half of breakfast, chewing slowly

documented_outcome: A denture sore spot was found; the denture was adjusted and intake returned to normal within three days.
limitations: The tiredness is not explained in the record.

case_summary: Over four days, resident ate less, was tired, urinated much more often and then became confused with a fever.

timeline.note: Asking for the toilet every hour, small amounts

documented_outcome: Urinary tract infection confirmed by culture alongside the new fever and urinary symptoms; antibiotics given.
limitations: Urine sample collected on day 4, after symptoms had progressed.

case_summary: Over four days, resident ate less and was reluctant to walk, guarding one hip and wincing on standing.

timeline.note: Reluctant to walk, guarding left hip

documented_outcome: Hip pain traced to an unreported fall; X-ray showed no fracture. Physiotherapy started.
limitations: Date of the fall is unknown.

case_summary: Over six days, resident ate less, slept propped up and became short of breath walking short distances.

timeline.note: Stopped to rest walking to dining room
Woke at night short of breath, slept propped up

documented_outcome: Worsening heart failure; the NP adjusted medications and swelling and walking improved.
limitations: Daily weights missing on three days.

case_summary: Over three days, resident ate less and limped, saying their foot hurt.

timeline.note: Said right foot hurt in shoe

documented_outcome: A painful foot wound was found during a bath; wound care started and walking improved as it healed.
limitations: Skin check frequency not documented.

case_summary: Resident ate less and needed more help walking for five days.
documented_outcome: No medical cause found; the resident's damaged walker was replaced and intake returned to baseline.
limitations: Unclear whether the two changes were related.

case_summary: Over a week, resident ate less, took longer at meals and shuffled more when walking.

timeline.note: Took over an hour to eat half of lunch

documented_outcome: NP noted progression of Parkinson's disease; care plan updated to more assistance at meals and walking.
limitations: Neurology follow-up not included.

case_summary: Over three days, resident was drowsy and unsteady in the mornings after a new sleeping pill.
documented_outcome: Over-sedation after a new sleep medication; medication stopped and resident back to usual by day 5.
limitations: Medication start date recorded only in pharmacy notes.

case_summary: Over four days, resident was tired and needed rests while walking.

timeline.note: Needed rests walking to dining room

documented_outcome: Low hemoglobin found on bloodwork; the NP arranged further investigation and started iron.
limitations: Investigation results are not in this record.

case_summary: For two days after a late family outing, resident slept in, was tired and slightly unsteady.
documented_outcome: Changes resolved after one day; attributed to the late-night outing.
limitations: Single-shift observation only.

case_summary: Over five days, resident was drowsy and increasingly unsteady, then fell.
documented_outcome: Transferred to hospital on day 5 after a fall with head strike; returned to the home after two days.
limitations: Hospital findings summarized only briefly.

case_summary: Over six days, resident was sluggish and slow walking.
documented_outcome: Hypothyroidism found on bloodwork; thyroid medication adjusted with gradual improvement.
limitations: No prior thyroid results for comparison.

case_summary: Resident ate less for three days after the menu changed.

timeline.note: Left most of new menu items

documented_outcome: Resident disliked the new menu items; the dietitian added preferred alternatives and intake recovered.
limitations: Fluid intake not recorded.

case_summary: Over five days, resident ate less, avoided drinks and coughed during meals.

timeline.note: Coughing while eating, ate about half
Coughed after sips of water, pushed cup away

documented_outcome: Swallowing difficulty identified by a speech-language pathologist; diet and fluid texture changed.
limitations: No choking events documented before the referral.

case_summary: Resident ate less for two days.
documented_outcome: Intake returned to normal on day 3; no cause recorded.
limitations: No assessment documented.

case_summary: Over a week, resident ate less at most meals.
documented_outcome: Weight loss of 3 kg over a month confirmed; the dietitian started supplements.
limitations: Weights recorded monthly only.

case_summary: Over four days, resident ate less, reported nausea and had loose stools.

timeline.note: Nauseated, ate about half of breakfast

documented_outcome: Nausea and loose stools attributed to a new antibiotic for a skin infection; resolved after the course ended.
limitations: Antibiotic name not recorded in this case.

case_summary: Over three days, resident slept badly at night and was tired during the day.

timeline.note: Woken repeatedly by roommate at night

documented_outcome: Sleep disrupted by a noisy roommate; a room change resolved the daytime tiredness.
limitations: Night-shift notes are sparse.

case_summary: Over five days, resident withdrew from activities and people and seemed low in energy.

timeline.note: Stayed in room most of the day

documented_outcome: Depression screening was positive; the physician started treatment and engagement improved over several weeks.
limitations: Screening tool not named.

case_summary: Resident was tired for two days.
documented_outcome: Tiredness resolved by day 3; no cause found.
limitations: No vital signs recorded.

case_summary: Over four days, resident walked less and complained of knee pain.
documented_outcome: Knee osteoarthritis flare; pain medication and physiotherapy improved walking.
limitations: No pain score recorded before day 2.

case_summary: Resident was unsteady walking for two days after getting new shoes.
documented_outcome: New shoes were causing instability; the resident returned to old footwear and walking normalized.
limitations: Single observer.

case_summary: Over six days, resident was dizzy and unsteady when standing.
documented_outcome: Dizziness on standing confirmed; blood pressure medication reduced and falls risk lowered.
limitations: Standing blood pressure checked only once.

case_summary: Over three days, resident was increasingly unsteady, then had an unwitnessed fall with hip pain.

timeline.note: Found on floor, unable to stand

documented_outcome: Transferred to hospital for a hip fracture after the unwitnessed fall on day 3.
limitations: The earlier mobility change is not linked to the fall in the record.

case_summary: Over five days, resident's appetite improved after dentures were relined.
documented_outcome: Intake stayed at baseline over the following month.
limitations: No weight recorded after the change.

case_summary: Over a week of physiotherapy, resident needed less help walking.
documented_outcome: Physiotherapy goals met; resident discharged from the program.
limitations: Physiotherapy notes summarized, not attached.

case_summary: Over four days, resident became more alert after a sedating medication was stopped.
documented_outcome: Resident stayed alert; medication not restarted.
limitations: Reason for the original medication not recorded.

case_summary: Over six days of recovery from influenza, resident ate and drank more and had more energy.

timeline.note: Drinking most of each cup again

documented_outcome: Resident returned to usual routine; no complications.
limitations: Influenza onset is described in a separate record.

case_summary: Over three days with a new walker, resident walked more steadily.
documented_outcome: No falls in the following month.
limitations: Short observation window.

case_summary: Over four days on a nutrition supplement, resident's intake improved.
documented_outcome: Dietitian continued the supplement; weight stable at the next monthly check.
limitations: Intake before the supplement recorded for only two days.

case_summary: Over a week after returning from hospital, resident regained energy, walking and social contact.

timeline.note: Tired, resting most of the day
Back at usual table for dinner
Walking to dining room with standby

documented_outcome: Resident returned to pre-hospital level of function.
limitations: Hospital stay details not included.

case_summary: Over five days as a foot wound healed, resident had less pain, ate more and walked more.
documented_outcome: Wound healed; resident back to usual mobility.
limitations: Wound measurements not recorded.

case_summary: Over three days, resident drank less and urinated less often, with dark urine.

timeline.note: Drank about a third of usual fluids
Voided twice on day shift, urine dark

documented_outcome: Mild dehydration found on bloodwork; scheduled drinks offered every hour and urine output returned to normal.
limitations: Fluid intake was estimated, not measured.

case_summary: Over four days, resident drank less, urinated less, then became confused in the afternoons.

timeline.note: Confused and restless in the afternoon

documented_outcome: Dehydration with delirium; fluids given under the skin in the home for two days and confusion cleared by day 6.
limitations: No bladder scan done to rule out retention.

case_summary: For three days during a heat wave, resident drank less than needed and urinated less.

timeline.note: Drank usual amount but sweating in warm room

documented_outcome: The unit's air conditioning had failed; extra fluids and a fan were provided and urine output recovered once cooling was restored.
limitations: Room temperature was not logged.

case_summary: Over three days, resident needed the toilet far more often and became confused.

timeline.note: Toileting every hour, burning when voiding
Picking at clothes, not following conversation

documented_outcome: Urinary tract infection confirmed with fever and painful urination; antibiotics given and confusion resolved.
limitations: Temperature not recorded on day 1.

case_summary: Over two days, resident urinated much more often after a medication change.

timeline.note: Voiding every two hours on day shift

documented_outcome: The NP confirmed an expected effect of an increased diuretic dose; the toileting schedule was adjusted.
limitations: Weight not checked after the dose change.

case_summary: Over four days, resident was up many times at night to urinate and slept poorly.

timeline.note: Up four times overnight to void

documented_outcome: Night-time urination linked to large evening drinks; fluids were moved earlier in the day and sleep improved.
limitations: Day-time voiding not recorded.

case_summary: Over three days, resident had diarrhea, ate and drank less; several others on the unit had the same.

timeline.note: Three loose stools on day shift

documented_outcome: Norovirus outbreak confirmed by public health; resident isolated and recovered in the home within four days.
limitations: Stool sample results reported for the unit, not this resident.

case_summary: For two days, resident had frequent loose stools.
documented_outcome: Linked to a laxative given on top of the usual bowel routine; laxative held for two days and stools returned to normal.
limitations: Bowel routine before the change not documented.

case_summary: Over four days, resident had no bowel movement, then abdominal pain and stopped eating.

timeline.note: No bowel movement for four days

documented_outcome: Transferred to hospital on day 4 for a suspected bowel obstruction; admitted for treatment.
limitations: Earlier bowel records missing for one week.

case_summary: Over five days after starting a new pain medication, resident had no bowel movement.

timeline.note: No bowel movement since new medication

documented_outcome: Constipation from a new opioid; the NP added a bowel routine and movements resumed on day 6.
limitations: Fluid intake not recorded.

case_summary: Over three days, resident slept badly, was drowsy by day and newly confused.

timeline.note: Awake and restless most of the night

documented_outcome: Delirium linked to a new bladder medication with sedating side effects; medication stopped and confusion cleared within a week.
limitations: Pharmacy review date not recorded.

case_summary: Over six days, resident was up at night, napping by day and withdrawing from others.
documented_outcome: Depression identified on assessment; treatment started and sleep improved over three weeks.
limitations: Sleep was not charted every night.

case_summary: Resident slept poorly for two nights after night checks changed.
documented_outcome: Night checks were switched to a flashlight; sleep returned to usual.
limitations: Only two nights observed.

case_summary: For two days, resident was suddenly confused, then cleared.

timeline.note: Thought she was at home, asked for her husband

documented_outcome: Confusion resolved by day 3; no cause found on assessment.
limitations: Urine and bloodwork were not tested, so causes were not ruled out.

case_summary: Over a week, resident became more forgetful and stopped joining activities.
documented_outcome: NP attributed the change to gradual progression of dementia after ruling out infection; care plan updated.
limitations: Cognitive score last measured six months earlier.

case_summary: Over five days, resident's shoulder hurt and they stopped joining activities.
documented_outcome: Shoulder strain found; pain plan and physiotherapy started and the resident rejoined activities.
limitations: Mechanism of injury unknown.

case_summary: Over four days, back pain woke the resident at night.
documented_outcome: Pain plan changed to include a bedtime dose; sleep improved.
limitations: Pain scores recorded only on day shift.

case_summary: Over three days, resident withdrew after a favourite staff member left.

timeline.note: Asked repeatedly for a staff member who left
Stayed in room at activity time

documented_outcome: Resident settled after being introduced to new staff; no treatment needed.
limitations: No mood assessment completed.

case_summary: Over six days while family was away, resident ate less and spent more time alone.

timeline.note: Stayed in room during visiting hours

documented_outcome: Daily video calls with family were set up; appetite and social contact improved.
limitations: Family travel dates are approximate.

case_summary: For two days, resident complained of headaches.
documented_outcome: Headaches stopped after new glasses were adjusted.
limitations: Blood pressure not recorded.
